duration.text: The Stomatology at Central South University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3750 USD/per year ￥ 27000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK For Chinese-meidum programs.2.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)3.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included4.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant5.High school academic transcript 6.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.7.English proficiency test certificate If any, for English-medium programs; For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English

requirements.text: 1) Non-Chinese citizens who are in good health, hold a valid foreign passport, obtained a high school diploma or equivalent, and are willing to comply with Chinese laws and regulations of CSU. Applicants must comply with the regulations (JW[2020] NO.12) issued by the Ministry of Education of PRC.2) Aged between 18-25 (born before May 30, 2005). Applicants who are under the age of 18 (above 16) need an eligible guardian living in China.3) Language requirements: students who apply for majors in science and engineering should obtain a minimum score of 260 in HSK4; for medical and other majors of arts, a minimum score of 200 in HSK5. Students who cannot meet the requirement of Chinese language proficiency shall take a one-year preparatory Chinese language course and meet relevant Chinese language standards before embarking on degree programs. Applicants whose previous degree education was Chinese-taught are exempt from proving language proficiency.
